description: This file defines an Angular service called AuditService that provides in-memory logging capabilities for audit entries related to user actions such as moves and resets in a Tic-Tac-Toe game. It manages audit entries, offers methods to log specific actions, clear logs, and maintains a capped list of recent entries.

classes.name: AuditService
classes.description: An Angular injectable service that logs user actions with timestamps and stores them in memory.

methods.name: entries
methods.description: Returns a read-only signal containing the current list of audit entries.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Adds a new audit entry to the in-memory log, with minimal validation and a cap of 200 entries.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all audit entries from the in-memory log.

methods.name: logMove
methods.description: Logs a user move action with before and after board states, recording the timestamp.

methods.name: logReset
methods.description: Logs a reset action, recording the before and after board states with timestamp.
